_meta.description: Offline, extensible IoT CVE knowledge base for iotscan.py. Add entries freely. Matching is done case-insensitively against detected fingerprints (HTTP Server header, banners, UPnP manufacturer/modelName/modelNumber, service versions). This DB is illustrative/educational, NOT exhaustive - always verify a match manually before treating it as exploitable.

schema.match: object of fields any of which (regex, case-insensitive) must match the corresponding detected fingerprint field. Fields: server, banner, manufacturer, model, version, service, any (matches any fingerprint string).
schema.endpoints: optional list of HTTP paths the webvuln module may read-only probe to corroborate
schema.botnet: optional bool - true if this device class is known to be recruited by IoT botnets (used by the botnet-exposure audit; descriptive knowledge only, not an exploit)
schema.attack_vector: optional short string naming the typical ingress for this class, e.g. 'default telnet creds', 'firmware upload'

entries.description: Huawei HG532 UPnP/TR-064 remote command injection via the DeviceUpgrade service (used by Satori/Mirai variants).
'Misfortune Cookie' - RomPager <= 4.34 embedded webserver memory corruption allowing admin takeover of many SOHO routers.
Dasan GPON home router authentication bypass (append ?images/ to a protected URL) commonly chained with CVE-2018-10562 command injection.
ThroughTek Kalay P2P SDK flaw allowing remote attackers to impersonate IoT cameras/devices and intercept AV + credentials.
Xiongmai/NetSurveillance (uc-httpd) IP camera & DVR path traversal / default-cred exposure, widely abused by Mirai-family botnets.
Dahua IP camera/NVR authentication bypass via crafted NetKeyboard/loopback login data.
Hikvision IP camera/NVR unauthenticated command injection in the web server (via SDK put message).
Various D-Link routers: authentication bypass / command injection in web management (model-dependent - verify exact model & firmware).
Boa webserver (end-of-life, embedded in many cameras/routers) buffer overflow; its presence also flags an unmaintained stack (see Microsoft 'Boa' supply-chain advisory).
Wyze/iCamera-class devices: identity/firmware verification weaknesses - verify model & firmware.

Android Debug Bridge exposed on TCP/5555 without authentication grants a full device shell. Not a single CVE but a chronic Android-TV/box misconfiguration (ADB.Miner worm). Confirm with the adb module.
Chromecast/DIAL control endpoint (8008) reachable without auth allows unauthenticated app launch / rename / reboot on the LAN ('CastHack').
Roku External Control Protocol (8060) reachable unauthenticated allows app launch/keypress injection on the LAN if developer/ECP mode is on.
Samsung SmartView/remote WebSocket API (7676/8001/8002) can allow unauthenticated/weakly-authenticated remote control depending on firmware & 'allow unknown devices' setting.

Exposed Telnet (23) on an embedded device is the canonical Mirai recruitment vector: the botnet's loader brute-forces a small list of factory default telnet credentials, then installs a bot binary. Presence of open telnet is itself the exposure - verify the device is not internet-reachable and disable telnet.

Dasan GPON home router command injection in the diagnostics endpoint, chained with the CVE-2018-10561 auth bypass for unauthenticated RCE. Mass-exploited by Mirai/Hajime/Mettle variants to build router botnets.
Netgear R7000/R6400 (and related) unauthenticated command injection via cgi-bin; trivially weaponised and incorporated into IoT botnet loaders for home-router recruitment.
